title: The Annunciation
alt: The angel Gabriel, wings raised, kneels before Mary at her prayer desk beneath a great stone arch, as the dove of the Holy Ghost descends on her in a burst of light

title: The Baptism of Jesus
alt: Jesus stands waist-deep in the Jordan while John the Baptist, clothed in skins, raises his hand above him; a dove descends in a shaft of light from the clouds and onlookers kneel on the bank

title: The Assumption and Coronation of the Virgin
alt: Above Mary's empty tomb the Apostles look up in wonder as she is taken into heaven on the clouds, where the Father and the Son crown her beneath the dove of the Holy Ghost

title: The Assumption and Coronation of the Virgin
alt: On the clouds above, the Father and the Son crown Mary as the dove of the Holy Ghost hovers over her; below, the Apostles gather in wonder around her empty tomb

title: The Crucifixion
alt: Christ hangs on the cross under the INRI title; Mary and the holy women grieve with Saint John on the left, soldiers with spears stand on the right, and Mary Magdalene kneels at the foot of the cross beside a skull

title: The Lamentation
alt: Beneath the cross, the dead body of Christ, just taken down, is held up by his disciples while Mary clasps her hands in grief, a woman cries out with raised arms, and Mary Magdalene bends to his feet; the crown of thorns lies on the ground

title: The Madonna on the Crescent (detail)
alt: Mary, crowned with stars and surrounded by rays of light, sits on a crescent moon nursing the Christ Child

title: The Madonna on the Crescent
alt: Title page of a printed book: under a Latin heading, Mary, crowned with stars and surrounded by rays of light, sits on a crescent moon nursing the Christ Child, above a short Latin poem

title: The Resurrection
alt: The risen Christ, holding a banner, rises in a blaze of light above the sealed tomb, with cherubs in the clouds and the soldiers asleep or startled in armour around him
